top_signals.title: Baltic Dry Index Breaks Out as a “Perfect Storm” Hits Shipping
top_signals.summary: The daily benchmark measuring the cost of shipping raw materials across major global maritime routes is breaking out to a nearly three-year high this week, as Bloomberg reports that typhoons are squeezing the supply of Capesize vessels just as mining companies increase iron ore shipments across the Pacific and Atlantic. The Baltic Dry Index, which tracks freight rates for several vessel classes, including Capesize, Panamax and Supramax vessels, jumped 5.5% to 3,331 points in London on Wednesday, its highest level since December 2023. The index…

top_signals.title: US Army launches laser production with $465M contract award
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Army awarded a $464.8 million production contract to AeroVironment, Inc., this week for the Enduring-High Energy Laser program.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Behind the Making of the US Open's Famous Honey Deuce Cocktail
top_signals.summary: Aleco Azqueta, global VP of Marketing for Grey Goose at Bacardi, said that he loves that tennis fans get to take home a bit of US Open history when they buy an iconic Honey Deuce drink (and cup) at the tournament. Azqueta said that the drink has grown to be part of the 'center' of the US Open and creates 'moment of connection' for visitors.  (Source: Bloomberg)
